weapon.d: Grants Spd+3. At start of combat, if a bonus granted by a skill like Rally or Hone is active on unit or if unit's HP ≥ 70%, grants bonus to unit's Atk = 25% of foe's Def and inflicts penalty on foe's Atk = 25% of foe's Res during combat.

special.d: Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 30% during combat.
Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 30% during combat.
Treats foe’s Def/Res as if reduced by 20% during combat. Boosts damage by 20% of unit's Spd.

a.d: Grants bonus to Atk/Spd/Def/Res during combat = 50% of current bonus on each of unit's stats. Calculates each stat bonus independently.
Grants bonus to Atk/Spd/Def/Res during combat = 75% of current bonus on each of unit's stats. Calculates each stat bonus independently.
Grants bonus to Atk/Spd/Def/Res during combat = current bonus on each of unit's stats. Calculates each stat bonus independently.

b.d: Inflicts Atk/Spd-1 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Atk/Spd (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Spd-2 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Atk/Spd (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Spd-3 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Atk/Spd (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.

c.d: At start of turn, if unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Spd/Res+2 to unit for 1 turn.
At start of turn, if unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Spd/Res+4 to unit for 1 turn.
At start of turn, if unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Spd/Res+6 to unit for 1 turn.
